itens.trecho: Um dos melhores filmes da franquia. Dirigido por Terence Young, produzido por Kevin McClory, Harry Saltzman e Albert Broccoli, este é o quarto filme de uma franquia que atinge a maturidade após a consagração com "Goldfinger".

Sir, I'd respectfully request that you change my assignment to Nassau. Thunderball is directed by Terence Young and adapted to screenplay by Richard Maibaum and John Hopkins from a story by Kevin McClory, Jack Whittingham and Ian Fleming. It stars Sean Connery, Adolfo Celi, Claudine Auger, Rick Van Nutter and Martine Beswick.
Thunderball is definitely one of the worst Bond films, after the 1st act nothing exciting happens and it is rather boring.
